summary: Fully tested RE-PLATE v0.1 backend + frontend. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering auth, dashboard, products/inventory CRUD, movement filters, scale-events flow with correct financial_impact (2.5*280=700) and stock deduction, idempotency on duplicate local_event_id (returns duplicate:true, no double-deduct), manual STOCK_IN, user duplicate rejection, outlet/device creation, camera-events and sales-events. Frontend: Login with amit@chef-hire.in redirects to dashboard showing KPI cards (Total Inventory Value, Today Stock In/Out/Waste, Low Stock, Devices Online), Recent Movements, Device Status. All sidebar routes (/inventory, /movements, /products, /weighing-events, /devices, /outlets, /users, /organisation) load without errors. Core edge demo (/edge) works E2E: Simulate -> stability engine settles to 'Stable' -> product select (Paneer) -> STOCK_OUT -> Send to Re-Plate -> success toast, event listed as SYNCED in Events tab, and the same weighing event appears in /weighing-events with sync=SYNCED and correct operator/device.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True which requires HTTPS; fine on preview but note for local http dev.
seed() creates test data only if collections empty - safe but if a test creates outlets/products, they persist across runs; acceptable for prototype.

record_movement mutates product stock without a transactional lock - concurrent scale-events on same SKU could race (Motor is async but there is no atomic increment). For prototype OK; for production consider $inc atomic update.

CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env points to a different preview host than frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Since frontend uses Bearer token (not cookies), cross-origin works, but cookie-based auth would break. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed products/users/outlets/devices; they persist in DB but are prefixed for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. All endpoints healthy. Idempotency verified via duplicate local_event_id. Edge simulate flow proven to feed the ledger.
